title: fix CI for the enforcing PR gate: repoint mdatron (post-collapse) + pin v0.3.0 + run vsdd-cli's own tests on PRs (F3+F4)

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: PR #1 opened (github.com/magnificentlycursed/vsdd-cli/pull/1) — the repo's FIRST PR (confirms direct-to-main until now). Fixes: F4 (repoint magnificentlycursed/mdatron-cli -> magnificentlycursed/mdatron @ pinned v0.3.0; install cargo install --path .; drop the removed mdatron-core rationale) + F3 (repurpose mdatron-test.yml -> vsdd-test.yml running vsdd-cli's OWN cargo test --workspace + clippy; mdatron-test previously ran MDATRON's tests, vestigial). CI runs on the PR = the validation. OPERATOR ACTION: review/merge + enable branch protection on main requiring checks 'mdatron verify' + 'vsdd-cli test' (the harness-level restriction only you can set).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: PR #1 CI GREEN — both fixed workflows pass: 'verify' (mdatron verify @ v0.3.0) 1m16s + 'test' (vsdd-cli's own cargo test --workspace + clippy on ubuntu) 2m8s. Validated end-to-end: the repointed/pinned mdatron install works in CI, and vsdd-cli's own test suite now runs in CI for the first time (F3 gate, previously entirely missing; mdatron-test.yml had run MDATRON's tests). origin/main synced (162 commits, 2f2f7c27..d55b7f86; last direct-to-main push by design). Actions confirmed enabled + working; the STALE workflows failed on the main push, validating F4 live. READY TO MERGE. Operator actions: (1) merge PR #1 -> main's CI goes red->green; (2) set branch protection on main requiring checks 'mdatron verify' + 'vsdd-cli test' -> direct-to-main blocked, PR workflow enforced (closes #822 M1 at CI-block grade + M6).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: CLOSED — fully done and since twice superseded: PR #1 landed the repoint/pin + vsdd-cli's own tests in CI; the operator set the ruleset (19991782, active 2026-07-29: PR required, three required checks, no bypass actors — verified live during the #826 amendment review); the pins since moved v0.3.0 -> v0.4.0 (#830) -> crates.io 0.5.0 (PR #21, sibling checkout retired).
